title: Isotypic Components Commute with Compact Induction
body_html:
Isotypic Components Commute with Compact Induction

Let \(J\) be a compact normal subgroup of \(H\), let \(J\subset J_1\subset H\), let \(\tau\) be a \(J_1\)-module, and let \(\chi\) be an irreducible \(J\)-module stabilized by \(H\). Then \(\tau[\chi]\) is a \(J_1\)-module and \[ \left(\operatorname{Ind}_{J_1}^H\tau\right)[\chi] =\operatorname{Ind}_{J_1}^H(\tau[\chi]). \]
proof_html: Realize \(\operatorname{Ind}_{J_1}^H\tau\) as functions on \(H\). Since \(J\) is normal and the \(H\)-conjugacy class of \(\chi\) is a single isomorphism class, right translation by \(H\) preserves the \(\chi\)-isotypic condition. Evaluating pointwise shows that a function is \(\chi\)-isotypic exactly when all its values lie in \(\tau[\chi]\).
